subject: SIG: sample evidence for code review & secret custody — request and rollout matrix
messages:
From: Joe Pearson <joe@bluecrestsec.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: sig-portal@thirdparty.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG / CAIQ follow-up — requested SDLC samples (code review, CI controls, secrets)

Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As a follow-up from our SIG intake we need a small set of artifacts to validate the Secure SDLC controls you mapped in the questionnaire. To keep the scope small for this round, could you provide the following for a random 10-PR sample over the past 90 days: 

- PR-level code review evidence (PR IDs, reviewers, timestamps, and merge approvals)
- CI gate snapshots showing the job names that blocked merges (e.g., lint/test/scan) and their pass/fail status
- Secrets usage and rotation evidence for any CI pipelines that access vaulted secrets (who has access, KMS/rotation logs)
- Chronology of changes for any production-impacting rollouts tied to those PRs (change ticket IDs / approvers)

If you can provide a CSV manifest for the PR sample (PR id, repo, author, reviewer, merged_at) and any supporting PDFs/screenshots for the CI and secrets evidence that will be perfect. Ideally by EOD next Tuesday (27 Jul) if possible.

If there are any constraints around redaction or where to upload, let me know — we can accept a Google Drive link or secure upload to the sig portal.

Best,
Joe
Joe Pearson
Security Assessor — BlueCrest Security
joe@bluecrestsec.com
+1 (415) 555-0112
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Joe Pearson <joe@bluecrestsec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ follow-up — requested SDLC samples (code review, CI controls, secrets)

Joe — thanks for the clear ask. We're on it. Quick notes / plan: 

- We'll generate a 10-PR manifest sampled uniformly across repos that touched prod in the last 90 days. Karthik will run the sampling script and produce the CSV (we'll include PR URLs).
- For CI gate snapshots, we'll export the pipeline run artifacts (build logs / job metadata) and redact any PII; we'll include job names, statuses, and timestamps.
- Secrets evidence: we'll provide an access snapshot from Vault/KMS for the service accounts used by the pipelines, a redacted rotation log, and our secrets-policy PDF (v2.1). We will not include actual secret values.
- Change chronology: we'll link the change tickets and include approver names / timestamps for each production merge. If a rollout used a canary or gradual rollout policy, we'll include the rollout record.

We have one ask: for the rotation logs you may want a short explanation of our ephemeral token cadence (30m default) vs. long-lived certs for infra components; Karthik will document.

Target delivery: preliminary manifest and a Drive folder link by Thu 22 Jul, full package by Tue 27 Jul EOD. If you need a more compressed set earlier, tell us which artifacts to prioritize.

Attaching the plan as a short checklist in the Drive once Karthik runs the sampling.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Joe Pearson <joe@bluecrestsec.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 14:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ follow-up — requested SDLC samples (code review, CI controls, secrets)

Joe / Marcus / Marissa,

Attached are the artifacts per Marcus' plan. Contents summary below and short notes on methodology.

Attachments (uploaded to Drive, and also zipped to the sig portal as requested):
- pr-sample-2027-07-15.csv (CSV: pr_id, repo, author, reviewer, merged_at, change_ticket)
- ci-access-snapshot-2027-07.pdf (PDF: pipeline job list, job status snapshots, artifact IDs, redaction assertions)
- secrets-rotation-policy-v2.1.pdf (policy: rotation cadence, roles, KMS integration)

Methodology / notes: 
1) Sampling: I ran a deterministic uniform sample across the 12 repos that had production merges between 2027-04-20 and 2027-07-15. We excluded docs-only PRs and dependency-bump-only PRs (notes in the CSV). PRs were selected using the internal sampling script: sample_sdlc.py (seed=42) to ensure repeatability if BlueCrest needs re-sampling.

2) Code review evidence: CSV contains reviewer usernames and the timestamp of the final approval. For three PRs where approval was via an on-call override, we included the on-call approver and the override ticket number. We also exported the HTML diff snapshots for each PR to the Drive folder (link below).

3) CI gates: The PDF shows the job names (lint, unit-tests, e2e-smoke, snyk-scan), each job's run id, and result. Our CI is run on Jenkins for infra repos and GitHub Actions for app repos; both runs include the pipeline metadata we used. We redacted runner hostnames and IPs; full logs are available under NDA if needed.

4) Secrets / KMS: The secrets PDF includes the rotation policy. For the sampled pipelines we included a KMS access snapshot (principals: service-ci-bot, deployer-sa, ops-oncall) and rotation events for the last six months with event ids (we redacted key ARNs). Tokens used in ephemeral runner sessions are 30 minutes; we do not store token values in CI logs.

5) Change management: Each PR row in the CSV has a change_ticket (JIRA) and approver column. For any PR that triggered a production rollout, we included the rollout id and approver snapshots. Where a change used a canary, the record includes the canary window and metrics that were monitored.

Drive link (public within requested accounts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A7_example_shared_doc (see folder: SIG_Evidence_2027-07-22)
HubSpot record: HS-84239

Let me know if you want a different sampling seed or a larger sample size. Happy to run an expanded export.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ follow-up — requested SDLC samples (code review, CI controls, secrets)

Karthik / Marcus — this is great, thank you. The CSV and CI snapshots give us the traceability we need for the sampled PRs and the KMS snapshot plus the rotation policy addresses the secrets controls. A couple of quick follow-ups before we close this ticket: 

1) Can you provide the override ticket(s) for the three on-call approval overrides as a single exported PDF (we need the ticket header + approver audit trail)?
2) For one PR we noted a post-merge rollback. Can you include the rollback postmortem link or a short note on root cause and whether the rollback changed the change management classification?

If you can drop those two items into the Drive folder by EOD Thu 29 Jul we'll be able to finalize the SIG evidence package. Appreciated.

Best,
Joe
